mapper.update: UPDATE ranking SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranking_item_vote v JOIN ranking_item i ON v.item_id = i.id WHERE i.creator_id = #{userId} AND i.status = 1 AND v.user_id != i.creator_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranking_reason_vote v JOIN ranking_reason r ON v.reason_id = r.id WHERE r.creator_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND v.user_id != r.creator_id)
SELECT r.* FROM ranking r WHERE r.status != 3 AND r.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ranking_id FROM ranking_item_vote WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
